statement: When widening a route detector for slashless decorator paths, exact quoted-keyword matching is insufficient: ordinary state comparisons, event names, and configuration values can contain the same words. Require decorator context for common bare words and add must-not-credit fixtures alongside the positive route idiom before accepting the widening.
